meta.title: Buddy expert hub
meta.description: Browse, search and import experts, expert teams, skills and connectors in one panel, opened from the expert button beside the composer. Also adds a `/` skill command, an `@` workbench command, and a personal workbench panel that renders agent-written HTML pages whose data lives in CSV tables next to them. It reads the resource repository over the network, scans local skill directories, and keeps connector credentials in an encrypted file under $DSH_HOME. Turning the plugin off removes the panel, both commands and the workbench entry.
